limits: Pressure-only integration omits wall shear. Published total CL/CD includes the solver force accounting; the difference is not an independently measured skin-friction coefficient.
Subsampling a frozen Cp distribution tests post-processing resolution, not CFD grid convergence or turbulence-model validation.
TMR warns of high numerical error very near the trailing edge and reports more output digits than convergence tolerance.
No uncertainty bars, iterative histories, or solver residual histories are supplied by these three small files.
This study does not claim a local CFL3D run. Geometry is reconstructed using rounded published x/c, so tiny agreement with an original coefficient is not a full reproduction.
Near stall, 2D steady RANS and tunnel experiments have additional applicability limits; 15° is a published case, not an operational prediction.
